package courseplan

import (
	"context"
	"errors"
	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-learning-planner/internal/domain"
	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-learning-planner/internal/domain/repository"
	"testing"
	"time"
)

func TestDiagnosticInitialRejectsRandomRetryKeyBeforePersistence(t *testing.T) {
	repo := &createRequestRepository{}
	_, _, err := (Create{Requests: repo, IDs: fixedIDs{value: "44444444-4444-4444-8444-444444444444"}, Clock: fixedClock{value: time.Now()}}).Handle(context.Background(), CreateInput{StudentID: "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111", IdempotencyKey: "22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222", DiagnosticPlanID: "33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333", GoalCode: "go.backend", Intent: domain.PlanningIntent{Source: domain.PlanningSourceTeacher, Reason: domain.PlanningReasonInitial, DesiredOutcome: "go"}})
	if !errors.Is(err, domain.ErrValidation) || repo.calls != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("err=%v calls=%d", err, repo.calls)
	}
}

type diagnosticCreateMemory struct {
	repository.CoursePlanRepository
	request          domain.CoursePlanRequest
	creates, resumes int
}

func (m *diagnosticCreateMemory) CreateOrGet(_ context.Context, r domain.CoursePlanRequest) (domain.CoursePlanRequest, bool, error) {
	if m.request.ID != "" {
		if m.request.RequestHash != r.RequestHash {
			return domain.CoursePlanRequest{}, false, domain.ErrConflict
		}
		return m.request, false, nil
	}
	m.creates++
	m.request = r
	return r, true, nil
}
func (m *diagnosticCreateMemory) GetDiagnosticPlanningRequest(context.Context, string, string) (domain.CoursePlanRequest, error) {
	if m.request.ID == "" {
		return domain.CoursePlanRequest{}, domain.ErrNotFound
	}
	return m.request, nil
}
func (m *diagnosticCreateMemory) GetInitialAllocation(context.Context, domain.CoursePlanRequest) (domain.InitialAllocationCheckpoint, error) {
	return domain.InitialAllocationCheckpoint{}, domain.ErrNotFound
}
func (m *diagnosticCreateMemory) CheckpointInitialAllocation(context.Context, domain.CoursePlanRequest, domain.InitialAllocationCheckpoint, time.Time) error {
	return nil
}
func (m *diagnosticCreateMemory) ResumeDiagnosticPlanning(context.Context, string, string, time.Time) (domain.CoursePlanRequest, error) {
	m.resumes++
	m.request.Status = domain.CoursePlanPlanning
	m.request.FailureCode = ""
	m.request.Attempts = 0
	return m.request, nil
}

func TestDiagnosticExplicitRetryRetainsRequestAndResolvedPath(t *testing.T) {
	now := time.Now()
	planID := "33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333"
	input := CreateInput{StudentID: "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111", IdempotencyKey: planID, DiagnosticPlanID: planID, GoalCode: "go.backend", Intent: domain.PlanningIntent{Source: domain.PlanningSourceTeacher, Reason: domain.PlanningReasonInitial, DesiredOutcome: "Go backend"}}
	for _, terminal := range []string{domain.CoursePlanFailureAttempts, "DIAGNOSTIC_PLAN_INVALID", "COMPLETED", "NO_GAP"} {
		t.Run(terminal, func(t *testing.T) {
			m := &diagnosticCreateMemory{}
			create := Create{Requests: m, DiagnosticRequests: m, IDs: fixedIDs{value: "44444444-4444-4444-8444-444444444444"}, Clock: fixedClock{value: now}}
			first, created, err := create.Handle(context.Background(), input)
			if err != nil || !created {
				t.Fatalf("create %v", err)
			}
			m.request.Status = domain.CoursePlanFailed
			m.request.FailureCode = terminal
			m.request.LearningPathID = "55555555-5555-4555-8555-555555555555"
			if terminal == "COMPLETED" || terminal == "NO_GAP" {
				m.request.Status = domain.CoursePlanCompleted
				m.request.FailureCode = ""
				m.request.ResultCode = terminal
			}
			result, created, err := create.Handle(context.Background(), input)
			if err != nil || created || result.ID != first.ID || result.LearningPathID != m.request.LearningPathID || m.creates != 1 {
				t.Fatalf("retry %#v %v creates=%d", result, err, m.creates)
			}
			expectedResumes := 0
			if terminal == domain.CoursePlanFailureAttempts {
				expectedResumes = 1
			}
			if m.resumes != expectedResumes {
				t.Fatalf("resumes=%d", m.resumes)
			}
		})
	}
}

type diagnosticStateRequests struct {
	request domain.CoursePlanRequest
	err     error
	calls   int
}

func (r *diagnosticStateRequests) GetDiagnosticPlanningRequest(context.Context, string, string) (domain.CoursePlanRequest, error) {
	r.calls++
	return r.request, r.err
}

func TestDiagnosticPlanningStateOwnerEmptyAndConflict(t *testing.T) {
	studentID, planID := "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111", "33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333"
	plans := &diagnosticProcessorRepository{plan: diagnosticRecordForCoursePlan(t, studentID, planID)}
	requests := &diagnosticStateRequests{err: domain.ErrNotFound}
	get := GetDiagnosticPlanning{Plans: plans, Requests: requests}
	state, err := get.Handle(context.Background(), studentID, planID)
	if err != nil || state.Request != nil || state.Schema != "diagnostic-planning-state.v1" || state.GoalCode != "go.backend" {
		t.Fatalf("state=%#v err=%v", state, err)
	}
	_, err = get.Handle(context.Background(), "22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222", planID)
	if !errors.Is(err, domain.ErrNotFound) || requests.calls != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("foreign owner err=%v calls=%d", err, requests.calls)
	}
	requests.err = domain.ErrConflict
	_, err = get.Handle(context.Background(), studentID, planID)
	if !errors.Is(err, domain.ErrConflict) {
		t.Fatalf("ambiguous=%v", err)
	}
	requests.err = nil
	requests.request = domain.CoursePlanRequest{ID: planID, StudentID: studentID, DiagnosticPlanID: planID, GoalCode: "go.backend", Status: domain.CoursePlanFailed, FailureCode: domain.CoursePlanFailureAttempts, Intent: domain.PlanningIntent{Source: domain.PlanningSourceTeacher, Reason: domain.PlanningReasonInitial}}
	state, err = get.Handle(context.Background(), studentID, planID)
	if err != nil || state.Request == nil || state.Request.FailureCode != domain.CoursePlanFailureAttempts {
		t.Fatalf("failed projection %#v %v", state, err)
	}
	requests.request.GoalCode = "other"
	_, err = get.Handle(context.Background(), studentID, planID)
	if !errors.Is(err, domain.ErrConflict) {
		t.Fatalf("foreign context=%v", err)
	}
}

type initialAllocationMemory struct {
	checkpoint domain.InitialAllocationCheckpoint
	err        error
}

func (r *initialAllocationMemory) GetInitialAllocation(context.Context, domain.CoursePlanRequest) (domain.InitialAllocationCheckpoint, error) {
	return r.checkpoint, r.err
}
func (r *initialAllocationMemory) CheckpointInitialAllocation(context.Context, domain.CoursePlanRequest, domain.InitialAllocationCheckpoint, time.Time) error {
	return errors.New("unexpected rebuild")
}
func (r *initialAllocationMemory) ResumeDiagnosticPlanning(context.Context, string, string, time.Time) (domain.CoursePlanRequest, error) {
	return domain.CoursePlanRequest{}, errors.New("unused")
}

func TestDiagnosticAllocatedInitialReplayNeverReplansOrReadsMutableInputs(t *testing.T) {
	now := time.Date(2026, 9, 1, 10, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC)
	request := planningRequest(now)
	request.DiagnosticPlanID = "33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333"
	request.Intent.Source = domain.PlanningSourceTeacher
	request.LearningPathID = "77777777-7777-4777-8777-777777777777"
	checkpoint := domain.InitialAllocationCheckpoint{StudentID: request.StudentID, RequestID: request.ID, DiagnosticPlanID: request.DiagnosticPlanID, Replacement: domain.LearningPathReplacement{PlanningRequestID: request.ID, CourseID: "44444444-4444-4444-8444-444444444444", GoalCode: request.GoalCode, CourseFingerprint: "frozen-fingerprint", PlannerPolicyVersion: domain.PlannerVersion, ReasonCode: "initial_plan", Items: []domain.LearningPathItem{{ReferenceType: "lesson", ReferenceID: "55555555-5555-4555-8555-555555555555", Status: domain.LearningPathItemReady, ReasonCode: "first_current_gap"}}}}
	checkpoint.Replacement.ExpectedOnboardingVersion = 1
	checkpoint.Replacement.ExpectedDirectionCode = "backend"
	checkpoint.Replacement.ReasonSummary = "Go backend"
	requests := &processorRequestRepository{claimed: request, completeErr: errors.New("lost terminal acknowledgement")}
	student := &processorStudentService{}
	processor := testProcessor(now, requests, student, &processorCourseService{})
	processor.InitialAllocations = &initialAllocationMemory{checkpoint: checkpoint}
	_, err := processor.ProcessNext(context.Background())
	if err == nil {
		t.Fatal("expected lost terminal acknowledgement")
	}
	requests.completeErr = nil
	_, err = processor.ProcessNext(context.Background())
	if err != nil || student.createCalls != 2 || student.replanCalls != 0 || student.planningStateCalls != 0 || requests.completed == nil || student.created.CourseFingerprint != "frozen-fingerprint" {
		t.Fatalf("replay err=%v student=%#v result=%#v", err, student, requests.completed)
	}
}

func TestDiagnosticInitialCheckpointTransientReadRetries(t *testing.T) {
	now := time.Now()
	request := planningRequest(now)
	request.DiagnosticPlanID = "33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333"
	requests := &processorRequestRepository{claimed: request}
	student := &processorStudentService{}
	processor := testProcessor(now, requests, student, &processorCourseService{})
	processor.InitialAllocations = &initialAllocationMemory{err: errors.New("connection reset")}
	_, err := processor.ProcessNext(context.Background())
	if err == nil || requests.retried == nil || requests.failed != nil || student.createCalls != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("err=%v repo=%#v", err, requests)
	}
}

type staleAllocationStudent struct{ *processorStudentService }

func (s staleAllocationStudent) CreateLearningPath(context.Context, string, string, domain.LearningPathReplacement) (domain.LearningPathAllocation, error) {
	return domain.LearningPathAllocation{}, domain.ErrDiagnosticContextStale
}

func TestDiagnosticInitialAtomicStaleFenceIsPermanent(t *testing.T) {
	now := time.Now()
	request := planningRequest(now)
	request.Intent.Source = domain.PlanningSourceTeacher
	request.DiagnosticPlanID = "33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333"
	checkpoint := domain.InitialAllocationCheckpoint{StudentID: request.StudentID, RequestID: request.ID, DiagnosticPlanID: request.DiagnosticPlanID, Replacement: domain.LearningPathReplacement{PlanningRequestID: request.ID, CourseID: "44444444-4444-4444-8444-444444444444", GoalCode: request.GoalCode, CourseFingerprint: "frozen-fingerprint", PlannerPolicyVersion: domain.PlannerVersion, ReasonCode: "initial_plan", ReasonSummary: "Go backend", ExpectedOnboardingVersion: 1, ExpectedDirectionCode: "backend", Items: []domain.LearningPathItem{{ReferenceType: "lesson", ReferenceID: "55555555-5555-4555-8555-555555555555", Status: domain.LearningPathItemReady, ReasonCode: "first_current_gap"}}}}
	requests := &processorRequestRepository{claimed: request}
	student := &processorStudentService{}
	processor := testProcessor(now, requests, student, &processorCourseService{})
	processor.Students = staleAllocationStudent{student}
	processor.InitialAllocations = &initialAllocationMemory{checkpoint: checkpoint}
	processed, err := processor.ProcessNext(context.Background())
	if !processed || !errors.Is(err, domain.ErrValidation) || requests.failed == nil || requests.failureCode != "DIAGNOSTIC_PLAN_INVALID" || requests.retried != nil || requests.completed != nil || requests.resolvedLearningPathID != "" {
		t.Fatalf("processed=%v err=%v requests=%#v", processed, err, requests)
	}
}
